name: Hume Octave 1
access: Hume TTS API: HTTP, streamed HTTP and WebSocket (wss://api.hume.ai/v0/tts), request field version set to 1
Hume Platform TTS Playground and Voice Design page
Integrations: LiveKit, Pipecat, Vapi, Agora and the Vercel AI SDK

voice.input_audio: none: the model takes text, with optional acting instructions in the description field and [pause] tags in the text
voice.output_audio: MP3, WAV or PCM; the sample rate rose from 24 kHz to 48 kHz on 2025-04-04 [hume-tts-overview] [hume-changelog]
voice.voices: custom cloning from about 15 seconds of audio, voice design from a text description, and a Voice Library of premade voices [hume-tts-overview] [hume-voice-guide]
voice.latency: About 200 ms model latency per the Octave version table of the maker; instant mode streams the first audio in about 200 ms [hume-tts-overview]
voice.session_limit: 5,000 characters of text and 1,000 characters of description per utterance, and at most 5 generations per request [hume-tts-overview]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token. Hume sells monthly plans with included characters: Free US$0 (10,000 characters), Starter US$3 (30,000), Creator US$14 (140,000; US$7 in the first month at 50% off), Pro US$70 (1,000,000), Scale US$200 (3,300,000) and Business US$500 (10,000,000); Enterprise is custom. Additional characters cost US$0.15 per 1,000 on Creator, US$0.12 on Pro, US$0.10 on Scale and US$0.05 on Business; the page shows no overage rate for Free and Starter, and Enterprise is custom [hume-pricing]. Artificial Analysis lists US$87.50 per 1M characters, which matches no plan figure [aa-tts-board]. Hume ends both APIs on 2026-11-13 [hume-changelog]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (text-to-speech leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind pairwise listener votes; the quality Elo in the leaderboard data of the page, read on 2026-10-04

benchmarks.name: Hume blind listener test against ElevenLabs: share of trials in which Octave was chosen as the better match to the given description or prompt (180 raters)
benchmarks.setting: launch post of 2025-02-26; the post gives 71.6 for audio quality and 51.7 for naturalness in the same test; it does not say whether the prompts were voice descriptions or acting instructions

unknown: context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model; the limit is in characters, see voice.session_limit
max_output: not published in tokens; the limit is 5,000 characters of text per utterance [hume-tts-overview]
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs (US$ per 1,000 characters on a monthly plan), see notes
system_card: Hume publishes no system card or model card for Octave in the pages read
voice.turn_detection: not applicable; a synthesis model does not listen
voice.interruption: not applicable; a synthesis model does not take turns
voice.languages: the FAQ and the overview table give English and Spanish for Octave 1; the launch post says English with Spanish fluency [hume-tts-faq] [hume-blog-octave]
retires: Hume announced on 2026-10-02 that the TTS and EVI APIs end on 2026-11-13 at 12:01 a.m. EST and that account data is deleted afterwards [hume-changelog] [hume-tts-overview]
